notes.content:

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Specification Changes
notes.content:
The following fixes and changes have been made.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the selection of blessings at the altar was not working correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug where allies under the "Charm" effect could be released from restraints unconditionally.
[*] Fixed an issue where allies under the "Charm" effect would attempt to evade their own attacks.
[*] Fixed a bug where using item transformation could sometimes create consumables with 0 remaining uses.
[*] Fixed an issue where returning to the title screen with F5 immediately after transitioning to the game over scene caused the sound to stop working.
[*] Fixed a bug where message skip sound would continue to play if the player transitioned to the title screen during playback.
[*] Fixed an issue where the sensitivity increase notification for the penis would appear even if "Futanari" was internally enabled but suppressed in the options.
[*] Clarified the Chinese translation for the "Treat as Naked" option.
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Adjusted the timing for accepting dodge inputs during attack animations for playable characters.
[*] Added restraints as an accessory in the battle gallery.
[*] Added a "Camera Shake" setting to the options menu.
[*] Added a "Spatial Reverb Effect" setting to the options menu.
[*] Added a "Borderless Windowed" option to the "Screen Mode" settings.
[*] Added a "Screen Size" setting to the options menu. As a result, direct window size adjustments are no longer possible.
[*] Improved certain UI elements to prevent visual degradation at high resolutions.
[*] Changed mechanics so that excess damage dealt to enemies or objects does not reduce weapon durability.
[*] Modified destructible objects to no longer display 0 damage, except for breakable walls and doors.
[*] Brightened the post-battle arena lighting slightly.
[*] Increased the ease of semen attachment.
[/list]

notes.title: Notice of Upcoming Price Revision
notes.content:
To all players,

Thank you for your continued support of Succubus Heaven. We would like to inform you that the price of Succubus Heaven will be revised to $24.99 (approximately 2,800 yen) following the end of the sale on October 25, 2024.

[h2]Reason for the Price Revision[/h2]

I strive to maintain consistent pricing across platforms to avoid significant price discrepancies. Initially, I set the Steam price at $29.99, or 2,980 yen, based on similar titles in the same price range. However, upon further review, I found that this price was slightly low for the Japanese market and too high for overseas customers. To correct this imbalance, I determined that an immediate price adjustment is necessary.

[h2]Timing of the Price Revision[/h2]

Revising the price during the sale could be unfair to those who purchased the game at a discounted price upon release. Therefore, the price revision will take place after the sale concludes. Please note that the revised price will not be lower than the current sale price. If you are considering purchasing the game, the sale still offers the best value, so please take advantage of it.

While there may be future sales with discounts exceeding 30%, it is possible that the price during those sales could be lower than the current sale price. We ask for your understanding in this matter.

[h2]About the Revised Price[/h2]

Even after the revision, the price might still feel slightly higher compared to the Japanese market due to exchange rates. Although I considered lowering the price to $19.99, Steam’s regional pricing suggestions would result in an unexpectedly low price in Japanese yen. Therefore, I concluded that $24.99 is the optimal price.

We kindly ask for your understanding regarding this price adjustment. If you have any questions, feedback, or concerns, please feel free to reach out via comments or email. Thank you for your continued support of Succubus Heaven.

Sincerely,
Chaos Gate

notes.title: 『サキュバスヘヴン』 Steam リリース ＆ 大型アップデート
notes.content:
[h2]Announcement of Succubus Heaven's Steam Release[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44427098/9148f6e95c415324fd4f87afcc72ae5161a32457.png[/img]

The erotic roguelite action game *Succubus Heaven* will be available on Steam starting October 11. Additionally, [u]a 30% discount will be offered as part of a 14-day launch sale.[/u] The same discount and sale period will apply to other platforms where the game is already available.

[h2]Major Update[/h2]

To commemorate the Steam release, *Succubus Heaven* will receive its first major update as Ver2. The adult content will be expanded by about 1.5 times, along with significant enhancements in various areas.

[h2]New Location: Slime Pool[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44427098/53f8bc6d70e7a94c7ecd549552674cac81db6d87.png[/img]

In Ver2, a new location called "Slime Pool" will be added. In this eerie place, vicious humanoid slimes will attack exorcists, trying to ensnare them in lewd ways.

[h2]Game Over in Slime Pool[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44427098/f92da244e94ef0fdf069965de01cd65cde43ba58.png[/img]

As with other locations, a unique game-over scene will be added for the "Slime Pool," detailing the grim fate of exorcists trapped by slimes.

[h2]New Status Ailment: Futanari Transformation[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44427098/d53aaed4c3eddea6ab8f88498d40cc943fe72851.png[/img]

Upon inhaling the spores of the new enemy, "Myconid," exorcists now have a chance to undergo "Futanari Transformation." While transformed, they are at risk of receiving H-attacks targeting their penis from certain enemies, making battles more dangerous.

[h2]New Status Ailment: Slime Parasite[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44427098/8629c2893e7f654338329122d8ab295d1a97dbe0.png[/img]

When violated by slime-type enemies, there is now a chance of becoming "Slime Parasite". While the infestation has no immediate effects, if left unchecked, the slime will eventually grow inside the body and be expelled in a pseudo-birth process.

[h2]Weapon-Specific Attack Motions Added[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44427098/d57f29d216b2f0e2af8a7459691b822df801dde4.png[/img]

Ver2 introduces unique attack motions for four weapon types: dagger, straight sword (blunt weapon), great sword, and katana. Players can enjoy the challenge of choosing based not only on weapon stats but also ease of use.

[h2]Loadout Feature Added[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44427098/933563bbf2fc0fe55032c079ba2b67d6d1c2ae48.png[/img]

In addition to blessings, a "loadout" feature has been added, allowing players to choose their starting state. This adds variety to early-game progression and enables unique challenges, such as being strapped with explosives.

[h2]Arena Mode Added[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44427098/112698bd287c6488fb25e4348c46627688627b76.png[/img]

Enjoy battles in specific scenarios with the newly added "Arena" mode.

[h2]Other Additions & Enhancements[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44427098/08ca52f9cdb69fa4d3b277f1b2904aa4888dda63.png[/img]

[list][*]Special attack feature added to magic
[*]Enhancement values added to items
[*]Over 24 new items
[*]16 new blessings[/list]

[h3]Support for "Adult Toys" Integration[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44427098/72b3d5fac9375558f731ded90eeb4985e01d6ba1.png[/img]

By utilizing the open-source project *Buttplug*, we have enabled integration with various adult toys that can be controlled by the application. Supported functions include vibration, rotation, and linear (piston), and players can freely assign these to in-game erogenous zone damage or physical damage.

[h2]About Buttplug.io[/h2]

*Buttplug* is an open-source project designed to control hardware such as adult toys and fitness trackers. It supports many popular manufacturers such as Lovense, Kiiroo, We-Vibe, The Handy, and VORZE.

[list]
[*]Project homepage: [url=https://buttplug.io/]https://buttplug.io/[/url]
[*]Supported device list: [url=https://iostindex.com]https://iostindex.com[/url]
[/list]
